blocks.html: Robinsons Galleria Cebu, located along Gen. Maxilom Avenue, served as one of the first two sites of Cebu City’s initial COVID-19 vaccine rollout. Cebu City Vice Mayor Mike Rama as Cebu City vaccine czar appointed by Mayor Edgardo Labella, together with Councilor David Tumulak, led the vaccination rollout which started last March 24 as it targeted to inoculate Barangay Health Workers (BHW) and medical frontlines. To date, 1,836frontlinerswere vaccinated at Robinsons Galleria Cebu.
